summary: All 14 of Ariel's real-usage feedback items are implemented, merged to main (75533f46) and built as APK 1.2.0/10200. The product now reads durations one way everywhere and echoes them back before saving, counts pakalim instead of timing them, lets a saved pakal report be corrected instead of duplicated, and organises the home exercise bank by equipment and muscle group with drawings. The data model can hold more than one owner; the product deliberately still shows only one. Physical-device acceptance and the Lovable publish remain with Ariel.
product_state: Ariel can report a morning or evening pakal in counts, reopen it the same day and correct a number without creating a second report; add a dumbbell or rope exercise by picking equipment then muscle group, with the common exercise first; and enter 7.15 km or 42:15 in a Suunto field and see the app say back '42 דקות ו-15 שניות' before saving. Nothing on his device moved: no migration, no schema change, no data touched.
